integrity: Analytic argument supplies universal quantifiers and exact signs. A standalone high-precision numerical reproduction checks normalizations and examples only; no external or independent scientific validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact oscillatory coefficient is proved for an equal-rate directed three-cycle; arbitrary larger Markov generators, finite-precision algorithms, and higher inverse phi-functions are outside scope. Earlier general Bernoulli matrix-function formulae remain relevant prior art.
title: Two-state M-matrix rigidity and exact three-cycle sign resonances of the inverse \(\varphi_1\) function
